thread:
Alex (sales-eng): Urgent — APAC POC demo tomorrow blocked: pinning redwood-2.1 returns "404 model unavailable in region".
Priya (solutions): Which region + exact payload?
Alex (sales-eng): ap-southeast-1. Payload: {"code":404,"msg":"model unavailable in region","model":"redwood-2.1"}. We switched to redwood-2.1-quant and then saw intermittent 429s under burst.
Sam (eng-runtime): Triage: full-precision 2.1 not deployed to APAC (upstream image retired). Quant variant present but their test pattern hits the rate limiter.
Alex (sales-eng): Customer policy requires an exact model id in their config. Any way to keep the pinned id but serve an available variant?
Sam (eng-runtime): Short-term: create a per-account alias so their pin remains redwood-2.1 but routes to redwood-2.1-quant-apac. Scoped to their account only. Will need security + infra ok.
Nina (security): If aliasing, we need: KMS key id for the quant variant, a statement that weights were not modified (routing-only), and export of audit logs for 90 days to their bucket.
Priya (solutions): Demo is functional parity first; slight latency differences are acceptable. Add note in SOW.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll create canary (5%) scoped to acct-9900, then promote. Will also temporarily increase their rate window for 45 minutes to avoid 429s during demo.
ops-bot: deploy started: alias-create/1954445555 acct-9900 redwood-2.1 -> redwood-2.1-quant-apac (canary 5%)
Sam (eng-runtime): KMS arn: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:222333444555:key/apac-quant-9900. No weight changes; routing-only alias. Logs -> s3://audit/poc/acct-9900/1954445555/ (90d).
ops-bot: deploy promoted to 100% for alias-acct-9900-1954445555. audit-log: https://audit.redwood.internal/poc/1954445555
Nina (security): Reviewed KMS/audit path, retention ok. Approve for demo only; require SOW addendum.
Priya (solutions): SOW updated: temporary per-account alias + transient rate bump for demo. Production plan to be scoped (Dedicated/private with full-precision recommended).
Alex (sales-eng): Demo passed. Customer accepted the alias for POC; security signed off. Reverting rate bump now. Thanks team :)
